Description
Merrick Preparatory School is a unique small boarding school for students wishing to complete their secondary school education, improve their English language skills, and/or be prepared academically, culturally, and linguistically for university or college. It is located in Ontario, about 4 hours away from Toronto. Students who complete Merrick Preparatory School Grade 12 program, and meet all necessary requirements, receive an Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD).
